instruction: Modify the Ubuntu update-alternatives system to point the python symlink to python3.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it requires root permissions and persistent changes to the alternatives system that cannot be verified reliably in the evaluation framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - requires root permissions (sudo) to modify update-alternatives system
System-level changes to /etc/alternatives cannot be reliably verified in sandboxed evaluation environment
The 'infeasible' evaluator is the semantically correct approach for tasks that cannot be verified within framework constraints
Alternative verification approaches (checking symlink state, running 'update-alternatives --query python') would require privileged access unavailable in the evaluation environment
